message: No detected input validation: The code loads images directly via ImageFolder with no checks on file types, image dimensions, label validity, or any other structural/value-range guards.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from a local directory path only; there is no remote fetch, and no checksum or authentication mechanism is present.

No detected label flipping detection: There is no validation of label values against an expected set, no distribution comparison, and no use of label-noise detection tools like Cleanlab anywhere in the code.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preparation code applies only standard augmentation/normalization transforms with no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs on the training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code trains a model from scratch with randomly initialized weights and does not load any pretrained weights or serialized model files, so no integrity verification is performed.
No detected label distribution validation: The code loads datasets and splits them without any check on class balance, expected label set, or anomalous sample detection before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: The training loop contains no backdoor defenses such as trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses a standard Adam optimizer with no differential privacy library (e.g., Opacus or TF Privacy) or DP-SGD mechanism applied.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, CleverHans) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: The test set is split from the same dataset object used for training via random_split with no fixed seed, no hashing/signing of evaluation data, and only a single accuracy metric is reported with no independent verification.

No detected input sanitization: The code applies only standard torchvision transforms (normalization, grayscale) during data loading; there are no shape/range checks, schema validation, or rejection of malformed inputs on the inference path.
No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs are consumed directly with t.max() and loss functions without any NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or calibrated threshold validation.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a CNN-based image classification model, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
